public_state.prompt: Round up the three marked lanternwings in the terraced sanctuary. Choose a useful launch position, estimate range and height, lead each moving wing, and throw gravity-driven capsules.
rules: Capsules leave the lantern and travel through 3D space under gravity.
The wings continue moving in depth and height while a capsule is in flight.
A contact with a wanted wing is secure; a decoy contact spends ammunition but does not secure a wanted wing.

server_grade.feedback: 3D roundup replay: wanted 3/3; decoy or miss events 1; ticks 49
